# prompt strings are chat(u); locate answer substring as exact chars in prompt

for i,(f,tag,ans,u) in enumerate(meta):

    offs=encs[i].offsets
    ids=np.array(encs[i].ids)
    sel=[j for j,(s,e) in enumerate(offs) if (s>=a and e<=b) or (s<a and e>a) or (s<b and e>b)]
